metadata.question: There was a volcanic plume visible over Mount Etna at 1:37 am local time on February 23, 2021. Did the plume go to the western side?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use ERA5 hourly wind at 100 m (ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY) near Mount Etna (37.751, 14.993) around 2021-02-23T00:37Z (01:37 local CET). If unavailable, fallback to ERA5-Land 10 m (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY). Retrieve 00Z and 01Z, then interpolate to 00:37Z.
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable (reanalysis). Use a 15 km buffer around the summit and compute mean and valid pixel counts to ensure data presence.
3. Logic: Compute interpolated u,v. If any null/NaN -> C3. Determine if plume went west: west-dominant if u<0 and |u|/speed ≥ 0.5. If west-dominant -> A, else B.

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const etna = ee.Geometry.Point([14.993, 37.751]);
    const region = etna.buffer(15000).bounds();
    const utcTarget = ee.Date('2021-02-23T00:37:00Z'); // 01:37 local CET
    const start = ee.Date('2021-02-23T00:00:00Z');
    const end = ee.Date('2021-02-23T02:00:00Z'); // include 01Z

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallback
    let src = 'ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY';
    let bandU = 'u_component_of_wind_100m';
    let bandV = 'v_component_of_wind_100m';

    let col = ee.ImageCollection(src)
      .select([bandU, bandV])
      .filterBounds(region)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .sort('system:time_start');

    let size = await col.size().getInfo();
    if (!size || size < 2) {
      // Fallback to ERA5-Land at 10m
      src = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY';
      bandU = 'u_component_of_wind_10m';
      bandV = 'v_component_of_wind_10m';
      col = ee.ImageCollection(src)
        .select([bandU, bandV])
        .filterBounds(region)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .sort('system:time_start');
      size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (!size || size < 2) {
        console.log('Images: 0 within time window (after fallback).');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Get the 00Z and 01Z images explicitly
    const list = col.toList(10);
    // Find exact 00Z and 01Z by filtering; else use first two
    const img00 = ee.Image(list.get(0));
    const img01 = ee.Image(list.get(1));

    // 3. Processing: counts and means (detect C2)
    const scale = 10000;

    const count00 = await img00.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandU).getInfo();

    const count01 = await img01.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get(bandU).getInfo();

    if ((count00 || 0) === 0 || (count01 || 0) === 0) {
      console.log(`Images: ${size} (but valid pixels 00Z:${count00 || 0}, 01Z:${count01 || 0})`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const stats00 = await img00.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();

    const stats01 = await img01.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).getInfo();

    const u00 = stats00[bandU];
    const v00 = stats00[bandV];
    const u01 = stats01[bandU];
    const v01 = stats01[bandV];

    if (
      u00 === null || v00 === null || u01 === null || v01 === null ||
      !isFinite(u00) || !isFinite(v00) || !isFinite(u01) || !isFinite(v01)
    ) {
      console.log('Calculation produced null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Interpolation to 00:37Z
    const frac = 37 / 60.0;
    const uInterp = u00 * (1 - frac) + u01 * frac;
    const vInterp = v00 * (1 - frac) + v01 * frac;
    const speed = Math.sqrt(uInterp * uInterp + vInterp * vInterp);
    const dirToDeg = (Math.atan2(uInterp, vInterp) * 180 / Math.PI + 360) % 360; // 0=N,90=E,180=S,270=W
    const westness = speed > 0 ? (-uInterp / speed) : 0; // 1=due west, 0=no west component

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Mount Etna @ 37.751,14.993 | UTC: 2021-02-23 00:37 (Local CET: 01:37)`);
    console.log(`Source: ${src} (${bandU.includes('100m') ? '100 m' : '10 m'}) | Images: ${size}`);
    console.log(`00Z mean u=${u00.toFixed(2)} m/s, v=${v00.toFixed(2)} m/s | pixels=${count00}`);
    console.log(`01Z mean u=${u01.toFixed(2)} m/s, v=${v01.toFixed(2)} m/s | pixels=${count01}`);
    console.log(`Interp 00:37Z: u=${uInterp.toFixed(2)}, v=${vInterp.toFixed(2)}, speed=${speed.toFixed(2)} m/s`);
    console.log(`To-direction=${dirToDeg.toFixed(1)}° (270°=W) | Westness=${westness.toFixed(2)}`);

    // Decision: plume to western side if west-dominant component (>=50% of total) and u<0
    const westDominant = (uInterp < 0) && (Math.abs(uInterp) / (speed || 1e-9) >= 0.5);
    console.log(westDominant ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
